# openfoodfacts

**Tag**: nutriscore, ecoscore, nutrition, food, ingredients, web, database

## 简介

Dart package for the Open Food Facts API, a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/openfoodfacts/openfoodfacts-dart
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/openfoodfacts
